body:
Progress from a current-state re-audit + fixes (umbrella #1878). Verified each row against `main`; several were already reconciled since the 2026-06 audit.

### Status by row
- **field** `maxLength`/`minLength`/`referenceFilters`/`maxRating` — ✅ **done.** Server already honored camelCase; the objectui client form now reads spec-canonical `minLength`/`maxLength` too (snake_case kept as fallback) — objectstack-ai/objectui#2806 (merged). `referenceFilters` was removed in 16.x (→ `lookupFilters`); `maxRating` is a non-issue (`rating.max` is consumed).
- **page** `type→pageType`, `label→title`, `visibility` — ✅ already reconciled (spec-bridge renames `type→pageType`, `label` consumed as-is, `visibility` normalized to `visibleWhen` at parse).
- **dashboard** `title` vs `label` — ✅ **done.** `DashboardRenderer` header now falls back to spec-canonical `label` — objectui#2806 (merged).
- **action** `disabled→enabled` — ✅ already reconciled (renderer consumes spec `disabled`; `enabled` deprecated fallback, #1885).
- **flow** `http` vs `http_request` — ✅ already reconciled (engine registers `http_request` as an alias of `http` + canonicalizes on rehydration).
- **skill** `requiredPermissions` vs `permissions` — ✅ already reconciled (spec settled on `permissions`).
- **agent** `knowledge.topics→sources` — ✅ **done.** `AIKnowledgeSchema` now folds the deprecated `topics` alias into `sources` at parse time (canonical wins) — #3439 (merged). Authoring `topics` is no longer a silent no-op.
- **webhook** `object→object_name`, `isActive→active` — ⏳ **still open — needs a maintainer decision.** Spec `WebhookSchema` declares `object`/`isActive` while the runtime object + auto-enqueuer read `object_name`/`active`, with no bridge. Reconciling can go two ways (rename the spec to match the runtime, or add a parse-time alias/transform) — flagging for a call before I implement, since it touches persisted webhook rows.

Leaving this issue **open** for the webhook row. Everything else is reconciled. Note: `dashboard` and `webhook` are the two types with **no liveness ledger** — enrolling them in the `GOVERNED` set would have caught these drifts automatically (systemic follow-up).

Closing. Of the 8 naming-drift rows, **7 are reconciled** (field length keys, page, dashboard title/label, action, flow, skill, agent — see the previous comment for the per-row status + merged PRs #2806 / #3439).

The **webhook** row turned out **not** to be a live-consumer naming drift. On implementation I verified there is *no* consumer of the spec `WebhookSchema`'s `object`/`isActive` — the dispatcher runs entirely off admin-authored `sys_webhook` **rows** (`object_name`/`active`); nothing ingests the spec Webhook into a row. So the "quick alias" would have been an inert no-op. It's a **disconnected/write-only** case needing a decision, split out to **#3461** (with full evidence) rather than fake-fixed here.

Systemic root cause (dashboard + webhook have no liveness ledger → drift undetected) tracked in **#3462**.
